name: cable seated high pulley overhead tricep extension
description: A seated overhead triceps extension on a high pulley that keeps constant tension on the back of the arms.
instructions: Sit facing away from a high pulley and hold the handle overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your ears and elbows pointing forward.
Straighten your arms to extend the handle up.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower it behind your head.
Keep your torso upright and your upper arms still.
